title: AdaptDiff: Cross-Modality Domain Adaptation via Weak Conditional Semantic Diffusion for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
mechanism: Pseudo-labels on unlabelled target images train a mask-conditioned diffusion model, which renders target-style images from source masks to fine-tune the segmenter.
evidence: Seven public datasets, three modalities; improved segmentation on all unseen sets (abstract, no numbers).
adaptation: Train mask-to-image diffusion on unlabelled half-cut pool cells conditioned on house pseudo-labels of structure classes (busbars, ribbons, cut edge); render train crack/inactive masks into half-cut scuffed cells.
min_experiment: PF + 1,000 rendered half-cut cells vs PF, 5 seeds; metric E1 crack relF1@2 and recall@2 on half-cut cells. Kill: < +0.03 relF1@2.
prior_overlap: Partial: synthetic half-cut views (geometric) were n.d.; generative synthesis untested (D06 overlap).
